title: Device Fingerprinting Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional letter template to request information about device fingerprinting practices from websites and services. Easy to customize and send.
description: A comprehensive letter template to formally request information about device and browser fingerprinting practices from websites, apps, and online services. Helps you understand how your digital fingerprint is being collected and used.

sections.heading: Subject Line and Formal Greeting
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Information Regarding Device Fingerprinting Practices

Dear Privacy Officer / Data Protection Team,

I am writing to formally request information about your organization's use of device fingerprinting and browser fingerprinting technologies on your website and services.

sections.heading: Purpose and Background
sections.content:
As a user of your services, I am concerned about the collection and use of my device fingerprint data. Device fingerprinting involves collecting various technical details about my browser, device, and system configuration to create a unique identifier that can track my online activities even when cookies are disabled or cleared.

I am exercising my right to understand how my personal data is being processed and would appreciate transparency regarding your fingerprinting practices.

sections.heading: Specific Information Requests
sections.content:
I respectfully request the following information about your device fingerprinting practices:

1. Do you currently employ device or browser fingerprinting technologies on your website or applications?

2. What specific data points do you collect for fingerprinting purposes (e.g., canvas fingerprinting, WebGL fingerprinting, audio fingerprinting, screen resolution, installed fonts, browser plugins)?

3. What is the purpose of collecting this fingerprint data (e.g., fraud prevention, analytics, advertising, user tracking)?

4. How long do you retain fingerprint data, and what are your data deletion practices?

5. Do you share fingerprint data with third parties, advertising networks, or analytics providers?

sections.heading: User Rights and Options
sections.content:
Additionally, I would like to know:

6. What options do users have to opt out of device fingerprinting?

7. Do you respect Do Not Track signals or similar privacy preferences?

8. Can users request deletion of their fingerprint data from your systems?

9. Do you provide any tools or settings to help users control fingerprinting data collection?

I am particularly interested in understanding how I can protect my privacy while continuing to use your services.

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Compliance
sections.content:
Please also clarify:

10. What legal basis do you rely on for processing fingerprint data?

11. How do your fingerprinting practices comply with applicable privacy laws such as GDPR, CCPA, or other relevant regulations?

12. Do you obtain explicit consent before collecting fingerprint data, or do you rely on other legal justifications?

I believe this information is essential for making informed decisions about my privacy and digital footprint.

sections.heading: Request Timeline and Closing
sections.content:
I would appreciate a response within [TIME_FRAME] as required by applicable privacy laws. If you need any additional information to process this request, please contact me at [YOUR_EMAIL].

Thank you for your attention to this matter and your commitment to user privacy and transparency.

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]
